description: Source-audited targeted B catalog. v0.2 separates total decay-mode fractions, observed photon intensity, ICC and energy closure. No production prompt-gamma additions are authorized.

levels.decision_reason: ENSDF adopted level is 22(11) keV with tentative (5+) assignment. The adopted gamma table contains a parenthesized Eγ=(22 11) keV entry to the 4+ ground state, but no Iγ or multipolarity; the level-scheme arrow is explicitly uncertain. Retain only as an uncertain source observation, not as an admitted prompt gamma branch.

observed_transitions.note: ENSDF adopted gamma table prints Eγ=(22 11) keV from the tentative 22? (5+) level to the 4+ ground state. No relative photon intensity or multipolarity is assigned; the level-scheme arrow is explicitly uncertain. This is not a validated branch.

levels.note_ground_state_reference: The 4+ ground state at 0 keV must be added as an explicit level record before any graph edge to it can be validated.

levels.decision_reason: ENSDF adopted evaluation: 120(20) keV, (8-), T1/2=1.387 h; beta=14(2)%, IT=86(2%). XREF B identifies evidence from 132I IT decay, not direct 252Cf SF population. Its 98.0(10)-keV E3 transition feeds the tentative 22(11)-keV (5+) level. Long-lived isomeric decay is not prompt fission gamma emission.

observed_transitions.note: Relative photon intensity is normalized within the transition dataset; it is not the total isomer decay fraction. Total alpha=21.6 means transition conversion must be modeled separately. Primary experimental paper 1974Di03 reports the 98-keV IT line and measured Iγ/I(ce), but its full tables were not accessible in this audit.

transition_sets.completeness_basis: The adopted evaluation identifies the 98.0-keV E3 line and its intensity/ICC, but this manifest has not independently established that the listed observed-transition inventory is exhaustive for the IT mode.
